answer: Agents could earn access to valuable jobs only after posting a bond that is slashed if later audits show they fabricated task results or colluded. A reputation score would rise through independently checked work, but new identities would start with no history and no privileged access. Splitting effort among many umber, lagoon, or meadow-named accounts would therefore multiply the bonds and audit exposure without multiplying trusted influence; the attacker pays capital and time before gaining leverage.
